title: web
description: What the web page keeps in its own graph (components/fields.tsx `front`): never synced, and never a component of the graph it shows.

draft.description: text typed in one of the page's plain boxes (a comment, a new task, an edge's search) and not yet sent, on an entity of its own whose eid is derived from the box: kept across a reload of the tab, and gone once it is sent
